resources.string: Running as root. For apps the system keeps exempt, PULSE can drop the removable Doze whitelist entry and write the bucket anyway. Every write is read back: it is only reported as applied when the system confirms the new bucket.
Locked by the system. With root access PULSE could attempt an override.
Held by: the user Doze whitelist. Removable.
Held by: the ROM whitelist in /etc/sysconfig. A shell cannot remove that entry, so the system may re-exempt this app.
Held by: the framework itself, with no whitelist entry. The write may be reverted.
